summary: community.aws deprecated support for Python below 3.8, following AWS SDK policy, with removal in release 10.0.0.
questions: Does community.aws support Python 3.7 in Ansible 14?

answer_card.title: community.aws Python < 3.8 deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: Following the AWS SDKs ending support for Python below 3.8, community.aws deprecated **Python < 3.8**, to be removed in release **10.0.0**.
